attempts.summary: Configured daily log rotation for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 via /etc/logrotate.d/inventory (daily, rotate 7, compress, copytruncate, missingok, notifempty). Verified the config parses correctly, forced multiple rotation cycles proving compression, 7-rotation retention cap, and continued application writes after rotation via copytruncate. Completed mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 with `shutdown -r now`, confirmed the boot_id changed after reconnect, and verified crond, the logrotate config, and all rotated log data survived the restart.
